soldier: Major soldier: head brown tinged with red, thoracic and abdominal tergites yellowish brown. Head trapezoidal, length about 1.3 times the width, the posterior margin nearly straight; fontanelle in front of the midpoint, in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head and the postmentum both nearly flat, slightly arched at the fontanelle; labrum lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at the tip a blunt triangle; mandibles stout, longer than half the head capsule, the fine teeth at the middle of the inner margin distinct, with several incisions near the mandibular base; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 nearly twice segment 2; compound eyes small, dot-like; postmentum about four times as long as the narrowest part, the waist region in the anterior third. The anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both incised in the middle, the posterior more deeply; the angular projection of the pronotal lateral lobes inconspicuous, that of the mesonotal and metanotal lateral lobes distinct; hind tibia shorter than the head width. Minor soldier: head yellowish brown, thorax and abdomen paler; head trapezoidal, 1.2 to 1.3 times as long as wide, fontanelle in front of the midpoint, postmentum strongly projecting; labrum narrower and more slender than in the major soldier; mandibles slender, about two thirds of the head capsule in length, the mandibular body rather straight with the apex strongly curved; antennae with 17 segments, segments 2 to 5 nearly equal in length.
